propositions: CodeQL workflow originally ran on every push to main plus weekly schedule; push trigger was removed in commit 03ef, leaving weekly as the primary scan of new code rather than a backstop for advisories
Weekly cadence now allows newly-introduced SAST findings to remain unscanned for up to 7 days, whereas the intended 6-hourly replacement cadence would reduce this to 6 hours
The cost-based rationale for keeping CodeQL weekly no longer applies because navapbc/rebar is a public repository where CodeQL and GitHub Actions minutes are free
CodeQL workflow must transition from weekly cron (23 4 * * 1) to 6-hourly cron (35 */6 * * *) with staggered minute offsets distinct from sibling lanes

Test coverage in test_ci_main_push_policy.py must be retargeted to pin the new 6-hourly cadence and assert the distinct off-the-hour minute staggering invariant, while preserving no-push and workflow_dispatch assertions
